references.text: A parallel introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, showing the repeated pattern of divine revelation through Moses in the Torah.
The same introductory formula is used at the beginning of Leviticus, where the Lord calls to Moses and speaks to him.
The opening formula in Numbers where the Lord speaks to Moses, establishing the pattern for divine communication in this book.
Another occurrence of the standardized introductory formula in Numbers where the Lord gives instructions to Moses.
The same introductory formula is used earlier in the same chapter, introducing a new set of divine instructions.
